author: TeIq
content:
Closed with PARTIAL delivery. The wire-format + outbound publish surface landed cleanly. Tracking the inbound + UI follow-up as a new sub-issue under epic #105.

## Landed in this PR
- lexicons/polaris/escalation-message.json + codegen regen + mapping-matrix row
- polaris-types::EscalationMessage / EscalationMessageId / SignatureStatus
- polaris-types::lexicon_mapping::{to,from}_lexicon_escalation_message + InvalidDatetime error variant
- polaris_backend::federation::publish::OutboundPublisher::publish_escalation_message

## Deferred to follow-up sub-issue (filed)
- federation/peer_subscribe.rs NSID routing
- repo/federation.rs::materialize_message_from_quarantine
- federation/promote.rs dispatch escalation vs message
- api/dto.rs CaseView federation_threads extension
- polaris-frontend federation_thread component + CSS + page wire-in

## Why split
Agent's worktree branched off a pre-PR-1 base (recurring issue), so its full-stack delivery rewrote files in ways INCOMPATIBLE with main's #107/#108/#109 work. The bottom half (wire format + types + publish path) is additive and merges cleanly; the top half (case-view DTO + UI) needs to be re-implemented surgically on top of the actual #107/#108/#109 state to avoid regression.

Per architect skill "Partial but clean beats complete but broken".

## Verification (architect-run, all clean)
- cargo build -p polaris-backend
- cargo clippy -p polaris-types -p polaris-backend --tests -- -D warnings
- cargo test -p polaris-types --lib (54 passed)
- cargo test -p polaris-backend --lib federation (30 passed — adds 3 new federation::publish tests on top of #109's 3 + #107 #108's 27)
- cargo xtask gen-lexicons (idempotent)
